NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering Advisor - Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
  
We are seeking an experienced SCCM/Intune Lead Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This lead-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex SCCM/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. The Lead Engineer plays a critical role in NTT DATA's EPM service delivery quality, client satisfaction, and practice capability growth, supporting global accounts across the US, Europe, and APAC.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Technical Leadership Architecture
  

* Lead end-to-end design and implementation of enterprise SCCM/ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune environments for global client accounts.
* Architect co-management strategies, Autopilot provisioning frameworks, and Modern Management transition roadmaps.
* Own the technical direction for SCCM-to-Intune migration engagements including workload transition planning, timeline development, and risk mitigation.
* Define EPM platform standards, governance frameworks, and configuration baselines across multiple global accounts managed from India.
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Manager capabilities and provide technical roadmap recommendations to delivery managers and clients.

Enterprise Patch Management
  

* Own enterprise-level patch management programs — governing policy, SLAs, exception management, and compliance reporting across 10,000+ endpoint fleets.
* Design and manage Intune Expedite policies, WUfB rings, and SCCM ADR-based patching for complex multi-site global environments.
* Lead vulnerability remediation programs integrating Qualys/Tenable findings with SCCM/Intune patch deployment cycles.
* Develop patching governance documentation, escalation playbooks, and compliance dashboards for client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead emergency and zero-day patching response including containment, deployment, and post-incident review from India delivery centre.

Advanced OS Deployment Provisioning
  

* Lead enterprise Windows 11 migration programs including readiness assessment, task sequence design, pilot execution, and phased rollout.
* Design and deliver Windows Autopilot + Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large-scale global device refresh programs.
* Own OSD platform operations — WinPE environments, MDT integration, driver library management, and image currency.
* Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post-deployment configuration.
* Define device lifecycle management policies from procurement through decommission for managed global client environments.

Automation Integration
  

* Architect PowerShell-based automation frameworks for SCCM and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
* Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy enforcement, and reporting.
* Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
* Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.

Client Engagement Delivery Governance
  

* Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
* Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
* Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
* Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
* Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
* Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
* Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
* Azure AD / Entra ID — identity-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
* PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
* SQL Server + Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management-level visualizations
* Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
* Client-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) — required
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect or Security Engineer certifications
* Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Analytics and Intune Advanced Analytics
* Prior India-based delivery leadership for Fortune 500 global accounts (10,000+ endpoints)
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, India IT Act compliance, and global data residency considerations in EPM

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/B.Sc. CS or IT) from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent enterprise experience and advanced Microsoft certifications will be considered.

description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a confident, personable and target-driven individual to join our recruitment team, helping us identify and qualify candidates for UK care sector opportunities.

This is a phone-based, candidate engagement role, similar to an SDR position. You will contact candidates who have expressed interest in working in the UK care sector, introduce relevant opportunities and assess whether they are genuinely interested, motivated and suitable to progress.

You don't need to be an experienced recruiter. We will provide full training on our recruitment process, including what to say, how to structure conversations, what questions to ask and how to identify strong candidates.

**Your main objective is simple: connect with candidates, understand their motivations and identify those who are genuinely ready to take the next step.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Make outbound calls to candidates from our applicant pipeline and lead lists.
* Introduce available UK care sector opportunities and explain the recruitment process.
* Build rapport and establish candidates' genuine interest in the opportunity.
* Ask structured qualifying questions to assess suitability, motivation, availability and readiness to proceed.
* Identify candidates who meet the initial requirements and are serious about pursuing the opportunity.
* Explain the next steps and arrange follow-up calls or interviews where appropriate.
* Maintain accurate candidate records, call notes and progress updates in our CRM.
* Follow up with candidates via phone, WhatsApp and email to maintain engagement.

**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent spoken English and clear, confident communication skills.
* A friendly, personable and persuasive telephone manner.
* Confidence speaking to new people and building rapport quickly.
* Comfortable making outbound calls and working towards performance targets.
* Good listening skills and the ability to recognise genuine interest and motivation.
* Organised, proactive and consistent with follow-ups and record-keeping.
* A positive attitude, resilience and willingness to learn.

**Experience & Requirements**

* Previous experience in telesales, sales development, recruitment, customer service or call-centre environments is preferred.
* Experience with outbound calling or lead qualification is an advantage.
* Comfortable using Microsoft Office, Excel and CRM systems.
* Reliable internet connection and a quiet working environment.
* Own laptop and headset.
* Availability to work UK business hours.

**What We Offer**

* **Full training provided:** We will teach you our recruitment process, call scripts, qualification criteria and candidate management procedures.
* **Performance-based rewards:** Earn rewards for successfully qualified candidates who progress through the recruitment process.
* **Remote working:** Work from home with a UK-based recruitment team.
* **Clear targets and structure:** Follow an established process with guidance, scripts and ongoing support.
* **Growth opportunities:** Opportunity to develop within a growing recruitment and candidate engagement business.

**Who Would Be Suited to This Role?**

Someone who enjoys speaking to people, is naturally confident on the phone and knows how to have a good conversation while keeping it focused.

You don't need to be a recruitment expert. We are looking for someone who is personable, commercially minded, organised and motivated by results.

If you're confident communicating with people and enjoy working towards targets, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Collaborate across teams to assist in solving complex technical customer problems across our product suite
* Strong analytical and technical troubleshooting skills
* Impeccable customer service skills and display genuine empathy towards customers.
* Work closely with our software engineering teams to resolve advanced customer issues.
* Support New Relic customers by resolving various installation, configuration, and data exploration requests.
* Be an advocate for our customers to our Product Organization by providing feedback on feature requests and bugs that improve the customer experience of the New Relic platform.
Advance your skills through additional training and exposure to other features and capabilities of our Products  
* **Bonus points if you have**

  + Experience with other IaaS platforms such as Azure, GCP, etc.
  + AWS, GCP, Azure Cloud Certified or CKA certified.
  + Experience in Network, System, Database Administration.
  + Experience in a DevOps environment, Software Engineering role or Technical Support role.
  + Experience with New Relic products
  + Being comfortable analyzing and interpreting system/application logs
  

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.  
  
Qualified applicants may inquire about visa sponsorship (including transfer of a current H-1B visa), but the company does not support or sponsor O-1, F-1, or J-1 visas, or candidates who require commencement of an H-1B "cap case" petition for future work authorization. This position is to be filled as soon as possible.

Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.

We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.

**Our hiring process**

title: Partner Solutions Consultant
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll work alongside diverse, cross-border teams and supportive colleagues who share knowledge and want to see you succeed. Wrike is rapidly expanding its global partner ecosystem, and we are looking for a Partner Solutions Consultant (PSC) to serve as the technical authority and strategic solution lead for our resellers, system integrators (SIs), and consulting partners. In this role, you will scale Wrike's footprint by empowering partners to independently identify, design, and close enterprise-grade work management opportunities. By bridging deep technical expertise with partner enablement and joint pre-sales execution, you will directly drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue growth across key global markets.

### **Your Impact:**

* **Scale Partner Independence:** Design, build, and deliver structured technical enablement programs, certification boot camps, and hands-on demo training to upskill partner pre-sales and professional services teams.
* **Accelerate Joint Pre-Sales:** Partner on high-impact, strategic enterprise opportunities to conduct in-depth discovery, configure bespoke proof-of-concepts (POCs), lead hands-on workshops, and navigate technical evaluations, RFPs, and infosec reviews.
* **Build Repeatable Solution Plays:** Co-develop industry- and department-specific solution packages (e.g., Enterprise PMO, Marketing Operations, Professional Services, Creative Workflows) and integration blueprints that partners can repeatedly bring to market.
* **Drive Ecosystem Alignment:** Act as the primary technical conduit between partner teams and internal Wrike stakeholders (Direct Sales, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, and Product Management), ensuring direct visibility on roadmap requirements and partner-driven product feedback.
* **Measurable Value:** Directly influence partner pipeline velocity, quota achievement, productive utilization targets, and strategic Management by Objectives (MBOs).

### **Your Qualifications;**

* **5+ years of B2B SaaS pre-sales experience** in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, or Technical Architecture, including **2+ years specifically in a partner-, channel-, or alliance-facing capacity**.
* **Demonstrated Channel Enablement Track Record:** Proven ability to coach, upskill, and influence third-party partner teams without direct line authority.
* **Enterprise Discovery & Presentation Acumen:** Exceptional ability to translate complex technical architectures into compelling business value for audiences ranging from technical administrators to C-suite executives.
* **Technical Breadth:** Strong foundational knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, SaaS integration patterns, identity access management (SSO, SAML, SCIM), and enterprise data security/compliance standards.
* **Cross-Border Collaboration:** Experience supporting multi-region markets (e.g., ANZ, ASEAN, North America) with the flexibility to navigate varying time zones and regional/international travel as required.
* **Fluency:** Outstanding verbal and written English communication skills.

### **Standout Qualities:**

* **Domain Expertise:** Prior hands-on experience with Collaborative Work Management (CWM), Project Portfolio Management (PPM), or agile platforms (e.g., Wrike, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, Jira, MS Project).
* **Partner Go-to-Market Literacy:** Practical understanding of channel sales operations, including deal registration mechanics, Market Development Funds (MDF), co-selling dynamics, and tier progression frameworks.
* **Consulting or SI Background:** Professional roots in management consulting, systems integration, or client-side professional services delivery.
* **Ecosystem Connectivity:** Deep familiarity with integrating work management solutions across core enterprise software suites (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Adobe Creative Cloud, ServiceNow).

### **Team Dynamics:**

You will report directly to the **Manager, Solutions Consulting**, joining a high-caliber global team of pre-sales specialists, enterprise architects, and partner advocates. You will work in close daily alignment with Channel Account Managers, Regional Sales Directors, and Customer Success leads, serving as the connective tissue between third-party partner practices and Wrike's core technical teams. Our culture is collaborative, self-directed, and performance-focused—rooted in shared technical excellence, mutual accountability, and celebrating joint ecosystem wins.

### **Our Work Style:**

* **Methodology & Environment:** We operate in a collaborative hybrid model in Bangalore, balancing independent strategic initiative with deep cross-functional teamwork across global time zones.
* **Tools & Stack:** Daily work centers on Wrike for work orchestration and portfolio management, integrated with Salesforce CRM, Slack, Zoom, standard API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and modern enterprise productivity suites (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace).
* **What Makes This Role Different:** Unlike traditional direct-sales SC roles where you win deals one customer at a time, this position functions as a force multiplier. You will architect solutions, mentor external sales and delivery practices, and build sustainable enterprise capabilities that generate long-term recurring value through trusted global partners.

### **Benefits & Perks:**

* 18 calendar days of paid vacation
* 12 days of National & Festival holidays (10 fixed, 2 flexible)
* Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
* Menstrual Leave: Twelve (12) days per calendar year. Women employees are eligible for up to 1 day of menstrual leave per month.
* Parental Leave: 26 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity
* 2 Volunteer Days
* Group Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
* Term Life Insurance (Rs 50,00,000)
* Personal Accident Insurance (Rs 50,00,000)
* Monthly Broadband / Internet Reimbursement (INR 1500)
* Hybrid Working Model + Complimentary Lunch & Snacks

Your recruitment buddy will be Nandini Singh, Recruiter.

#LI-NS2

### **Who Is Wrike and Our Culture**

We're a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

**Hybrid work mode**

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

#### **Our persona**

**Smart:** We love what we do, and we're great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

**Dedicated:** We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We're committed to helping our teammates win, too!

**Approachable:** We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

#### **Our culture and Values**

**Customer-Focused**

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**Collaborative**

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

**Creative**

**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.** It's our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

**Committed**

**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

* Lead the preparation of Engineering Drawings using WSP CAD/ BIM Standards and Templates.
* Agree priorities & deadlines with Sweden Team, organize work to ensure timely delivery.
* Align work with Quality requirements and maintain Document Control for all work.
* Proactively raising queries, identifying necessary inputs from others & following up.
* Develop templates and libraries for CAD / BIM work.
* Role will be working under the supervision of Principal Engineer or Principal BIM Modeler.

  

* Prepare structural detailed and concept design drawings for various bridges and construction types to be built predominantly in Sweden.
* Responsible for BIM and CAD standards, implementation, and enforcement
* Creation and maintenance of the software template files to assure standards
* Automate routines to support standards and productivity
* Provide quality control for completeness and adherence to company standards of all drawings produced
* Assist in developing and enforcing BIM documentation and workflow process standards
* Maximizing utilization on projects
* Create Tekla Structures auto and customized connections / Templates in response to project requirements
* Agree priorities and deadlines for drawing production through liaison with the Project Engineer and Sweden team

Key Competencies / Skills:

* Cultural awareness, conscientious with an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role.
* High degree of self-motivation and ability to motivate others.
* Ability to work under pressure and with minimum supervision.
* Experience of 3D reinforcement skillset is a must in Tekla Structures - Concrete.
* Knowledge of Revit Software particularly in 3D reinforcement is an added advantage.

Mandatory Skills

* Diploma in CAD or Bachelor’s Degree
Experience of having worked in a similar role.  

Desired Skills

* Competence in Tekla Structures - Concrete/AutoCAD/Cads RC

  

* Minimum Diploma in CAD with 10+ years of relevant experience.
* It is desirable that the candidate has obtained professional registration such as EngTech with ICE, UK or close to attaining the same.

BGV:

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

  

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.

With approximately **4,000 talented people** across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than **73,000 globally** , in 550 **offices across 40 countries** , we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.

At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: **Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**

**www.wsp.com**

**We are**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

description:
Job description:

Cactus Life Sciences is a remote-first organization, and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.

If you are looking for challenging and rewarding work which combines your understanding of medical science and aptitude for writing into one unique job, the **Senior Medical Writer-Medical Information** role is for you. This is an opportunity to grow your career and make a greater impact on the lives around you.

Job responsibilities:

* Taking ownership and responsibility for development (write, review, proofread, and data-check) of high-quality, client-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meetings materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content according to client and audience needs with excellent attention to detail.
* Actively involve in reviewing materials developed by scientific writers to ensure strategic alignment and scientific accuracy as needed and providing clear constructive feedback, support, and supervision to writers. Mentor and train scientific writers by sharing best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the team.
* Having excellent knowledge of product/account to enable meaningful interactions with clients and authors, including consultancy where necessary.
* Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, and key stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and KOLs across therapeutic areas. This involves anticipating client needs, advising on strategic and tactical plans, and recommending improvements to scientific content and new ways to disseminate data effectively.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives. Attending client and other external meetings and supporting senior team members as needed.
* Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans. Also, supporting with the development of visual content and materials using effective data visualization techniques and approaches. Contributing to innovative “out of the box” solutions for medical writing projects.
* You will be responsible for ensuring all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS’ internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
* Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
* Supporting with pitches, both during the preparation phase and the actual pitch.  
  #LI-Remote

Qualifications and prerequisites:

* 3-5 year of experience in relevant fields of scientific writing.
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD OR M.Pharm/M.Sc with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
* Preferrable to have some experience working on Global Medical Value (GMV) Dossiers.
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail and excellent language skills.
* Ability to adapt writing style to different materials and target audiences.
* Basic knowledge of biostatistics.
* Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
* Very good working knowledge of MS Office.

Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process starts with a **Technical Interview** with the Hiring Managers, followed by a **Technical Assessment,** where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the **HR Interview.** All interactions will be conducted virtually via **MS Teams.**

**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**

The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.

AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.

We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.

You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.

**Equal Opportunity**

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

  
About Us:

At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.

Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

description:
**Internal role at Weekday** — not a role with one of our clients.

**Experience:** Fresh graduates or candidates with 0–1 year of experience  
**Work schedule:** 9 hours/day, 6 days/week; one mandatory working Sunday each month with a higher incentive  
**Role levels:** Junior Intern, Senior Intern, Contractor/Consultant, and Intern POD Lead

**About Weekday**
-----------------

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway, now part of General Catalyst. We help companies discover and connect with the right talent through technology and recruiting operations.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

Start your career in recruiting and talent operations at a fast-moving, YC-backed company. You’ll speak with candidates across India, help them understand exciting opportunities, and play a direct role in connecting people with the right jobs.

This is a great fit if you enjoy talking to people, have strong communication skills, and want hands-on experience in recruitment, sales, customer engagement, or talent operations.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Make outbound calls to shortlisted candidates and present the company, role, location, and job requirements clearly.
* Understand each candidate’s interest, availability, notice period, and other relevant details.
* Follow up with candidates through calls, WhatsApp, and email to keep the hiring process moving.
* Share interested and qualified candidates with the relevant internal team.
* Maintain accurate call logs, candidate notes, and records in spreadsheets or internal systems.
* Meet daily outreach and follow-up targets; this is a high-volume calling role with approximately 100–120 outbound calls per day.
* **POD Leads:** Coordinate the team, coach associates, monitor daily productivity, and maintain quality standards.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* A completed graduation; candidates with 0–1 year of experience are welcome. Current college students are not eligible.
* Clear, fluent spoken English and confident, professional phone communication.
* Comfort with repetitive calling, regular follow-ups, and daily performance targets.
* Basic ATS knowledge and strong attention to detail.
* Availability for the stated work schedule.
* Prior experience in telecalling, customer support, sales, or recruitment outreach is helpful, but not required for entry-level applicants.

**Compensation**
----------------

* **Fixed pay:** ₹5,000–₹15,000 per month
* **Performance bonus:** ₹5,000–₹10,000 per month

Your role level and compensation will depend on experience, interview assessment, and mutual fit. Incentives are performance-based and not guaranteed. Complete pay terms will be shared before you accept an offer.

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Software Engineer on GitLab's Authorization team, you'll help build and maintain the system that decides what every user, token, and automated agent can access on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. You'll work alongside experienced engineers who guide the larger design decisions, delivering well-scoped changes and growing into ownership of larger parts of the system.

Today, that work is Ruby on Rails. Roughly 400 policy classes and a catalog of about 1,900 permissions sit behind every application programming interface (API) request. You'll work on fine-grained token permissions, custom roles, and the GraphQL and representational state transfer (REST) APIs that enforce them. A single request can trigger hundreds of permission checks, so correctness and performance both matter.

You'll also contribute to moving the permission model to a new authorization stack that pairs the Rails monolith with a Rust policy engine. The engine represents access relationships and evaluates permission rules, and can run within the monolith's process or be reached through remote procedure calls using gRPC. You don't need prior Rust experience: several engineers on the team learned it for this work, and we'll support you doing the same.

Some examples of our projects:

* Refactoring GitLab's policy layer so the same permission definitions can be evaluated by the monolith and the new authorization service
* Extending fine-grained token permissions to more resources, with guidance from senior engineers on the design

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Implement authorization changes in GitLab's Ruby on Rails monolith so permission checks allow intended access and deny unauthorized access.
* Deliver well-scoped workstreams from feature-flagged rollout through verifying that the old and new systems produce the same results, with review and guidance from senior engineers.
* Build and extend fine-grained permissions for tokens and roles so additional resources have permission coverage consistent with the established catalog.
* Extend and fix authorization enforcement so GraphQL and the REST API enforce the intended permissions consistently.
* Make incremental refactors to long-lived policy code without changing behavior for existing customers.
* Investigate and fix reliability, performance, and security issues so affected permission checks return the expected results without regressions.
* Work with the authentication, platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) teams to document interface contracts that keep permission checks consistent as authorization moves toward a shared service.
* Contribute to design documents, merge requests, and code reviews so proposed changes have a documented rationale and review feedback is addressed asynchronously.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Solid experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, typically gained over 2 to 4 years or more.
* Hands-on experience with authorization concepts, such as role-based access control or fine-grained permissions, from work or projects.
* A security mindset: you treat a permission bug as a security bug and consider who a change could affect before choosing an implementation.
* Experience making careful changes to existing codebases, including incremental refactors and feature-flagged rollouts that preserve existing behavior.
* Familiarity with GraphQL or API authorization patterns.
* Awareness of performance, including how repeated permission checks can add up on every request.
* Strong written communication and the ability to work effectively when most decisions happen in a document or merge request rather than a meeting.
* Helpful, but not required: hands-on PostgreSQL experience, or experience with Rust, gRPC or Protocol Buffers, Cedar or other policy languages, Zanzibar-style authorization systems, Go, or service-oriented architecture.

We welcome transferable experience from adjacent domains such as identity, policy engines, and platform security.

description:
**About AlphaSense:**
---------------------

The world's most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients' own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

**About the Role:**

The AI Governance Analyst is central to building and operating AlphaSense's AI governance program, helping ensure that the way we deploy, build, and procure AI systems is well-governed, well-documented, and defensible to regulators, auditors, and enterprise clients. Sitting within the Strategic Risk team, this role owns the day-to-day execution of AI risk assessments — intake, classification, evaluation, and documentation — that keep the program running at scale.

As AlphaSense matures its governance infrastructure, including the rollout of a dedicated GRC platform to automate assessment workflows, this role acts as the operational backbone of the program: turning frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001 into repeatable, auditable processes that grow with the business. This is a risk and governance role — not a hands-on AI engineering role — well-suited to someone who understands how AI systems create risk and knows how to manage it.

**What You'll Do:**

* Complete AI risk assessments using established templates and criteria — gathering details on AI use cases, working through classification and control questions, and preparing draft assessments for senior review.
* Maintain the accuracy of the AI system inventory by adding and updating records of AI/ML systems, vendors, and use cases.
* Leverage the AI governance platform to enter assessment data, follow set workflows, and organize supporting evidence and documentation.
* Gather the information and evidence needed to map use cases against frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001, with guidance on interpretation from senior team members.
* Coordinate with engineering, product, security, legal and privacy, and procurement contacts to collect the details needed for assessments, and flag open questions for review.
* Assist with third-party and vendor AI risk reviews by collecting vendor documentation and completing initial reviews for senior validation.
* Draft clear, well-organized summaries and notes from completed assessments, and flag higher-risk or unclear items to senior reviewers.
* Track the status of assessments and follow-ups, keeping records and trackers up to date so nothing slips through.

**Who You Are:**

* IAPP AIGP certified with a strong knowledge of the AI governance landscape and the major frameworks shaping it.
* 2–4 years of experience in risk management, GRC, compliance, audit, or data privacy, with exposure to AI governance, technology risk, or third-party risk.
* Familiar with the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and ISO/IEC 27001, and able to apply their requirements to real use cases rather than just cite them.
* Comfortable working with GRC or governance tooling — configuring workflows, managing inventories, and generating reporting — and quick to learn new platforms.
* AI-literate without being a developer: able to understand at a conceptual level how AI and ML systems work, the risks they introduce (bias, hallucination, data leakage, model drift, and similar), and how to translate that into governance language.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, capable of managing a high volume of assessments, inventory records, and deadlines at once without sacrificing quality.
* A strong written and verbal communicator who can turn technical and regulatory complexity into clear assessments, summaries, and stakeholder-ready documentation in English.
* A collaborative, self-directed partner who is comfortable with ambiguity and evolving priorities in a function that is being built from the ground up.
* Organized, reliable, and able to manage multiple requests, track deadlines, and stay composed while handling a steady volume of work.
